title: Exhibiting at ASF 2026
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
We will be exhibiting at the Automated Synthesis Forum 2026, hosted by @AstraZeneca in Gothenburg on 10–11 November.


For 30 years, ASF has brought together the chemists who build and run automated synthesis inside pharma and biotech; we’re excited to be part of it.


Alexander Pomberger & Daniel Wigh will be there. If you are attending and would like to set aside time to talk, send us a message.


‍
